en.name: Galadriel
en.ability: Each night, learn if the Ring is safe. Once per game, at night, learn who has it.

revisions.v1: Each night, learn if the Ring is safe. Once per game, at night, learn who has it.

en.flavor: In place of a Dark Lord, you would have a queen! Not dark, but beautiful and terrible as the dawn! Treacherous as the sea! Stronger than the foundations of the earth! All shall love me, and despair!
en.firstNightReminder: Tell Galadriel if the Ring is safe (and if they want to use their ability)
en.otherNightReminder: Tell Galadriel if the Ring is safe (and if they want to use their ability)
